intro: From April to September 2026, ZCyberNews covered 61 ransomware incidents, with LockBit, The Gentlemen, and ShinyHunters appearing as distinct threat actors. The most frequently cited vulnerability was CVE-2026-1731, a CVSS 9.8 flaw, alongside CVE-2026-34197, CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. Coverage spanned healthcare, manufacturing, multiple, financial services, and government sectors, with reports from Global, North America, Europe, the United States, and Turkey. The severity mix included 45 high, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 2 informational reports.
